evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the time-boxed framing ('this will take 10-15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on') or waited for explicit yes before probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Tanya), moving day (October 16th), route (2630 Bissonnette, Houston to 5300 sq ft home ~30 min away), size (1200 sq ft + 700 sq ft = 1900+ sq ft total across two units), and apartment details all gathered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked: 'Besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call today?' — asked before any logistics probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised three concerns: (1) pricing, (2) how the move will be performed, (3) packing service. Rep followed up on each: 'Yeah, so basically like you know, we have two apartments in the same building...' and 'Because we don't, we don't really have like a lot of effect...' Rep dug into each concern with clarifying questions about elevator access, parking distance, unit configuration, and packing logistics across the two units.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep acknowledged concerns but never reflected them back as 'So what I'm hearing is X, Y, and Z. Did I get all of it?'
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Home is 5,300 sq ft (two-story, five bedrooms) plus the two apartment units totaling ~1,900 sq ft = well over 1,800 sq ft threshold. Rep correctly offered virtual walkthrough: 'Oh, yeah, no, we can definitely do a virtual walkthrough if you'd like and then I also can send you a link and you can do it on your own and it'll upload.' Customer accepted the walkthrough option and was sent a video link to complete the walkthrough independently before final pricing.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked: 'Would you like us to help you, would you like to hop on that schedule and then I can send you the live switch link to do the video?' — plain ask without a soft-out, though the customer's response ('Yeah, sending me the bank so that I can do the video...') deferred final booking to after the walkthrough video, which is appropriate for this call type.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial confirmation: Date (October 15 packing, October 16 move) and phone number (97-539-0137) confirmed, email confirmed. However, no arrival window, crew size, or destination address details explicitly confirmed at call end. Video link sent via text; no notes left for crew about customer concerns.

top_strength: Rep discovered two layered apartments totaling 1,900+ sq ft, correctly recognized the move required a virtual walkthrough before pricing, and cleanly transitioned the customer to the walkthrough process rather than forcing an incomplete estimate.
coaching_note: Always open with the quid pro quo time-box framing ('10 to 15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on') and wait for a yes before diving into probing — rep skipped this entirely and jumped straight into discovery questions.
